# Content Specification

## Overview
This document defines the requirements for the blog post content.

## Content Type
Blog Post / Article

## Target Audience
Software developers and technical writers

## Structure
- Introduction (100-200 words)
- Main Sections (3+ sections, 200+ words each)
- Conclusion (50-100 words)

## Word Count
Minimum: 800 words
Maximum: 2000 words

## Requirements
- Include front matter (title, date, description)
- Use proper heading hierarchy (H1 for title, H2 for sections)
- Include code examples where relevant
- Write in clear, concise English
